name: peerBench
observations: Published as 'peerbench' on npm (v0.0.9), MIT license, ESM only
Package manager: npm, Build: tsup + tsc + tsc-alias, Monorepo tool: turborepo

name: SDK-0.2
observations: New experimental SDK with runtime-first design
SDK owns: entity schemas, runner/scorer/provider contracts, storages, aggregators
Runtime owns: data ingestion, orchestration, secrets, migration strategies

name: Target
observations: Has slug (model/agent identifier), providerKind (provider kind string), forward() method
forward() takes TargetForwardArgs (messages, temperature, responseFormat, abortSignal) - no model param
Providers create Targets via .target(model) factory method
Named 'Target' because 'Model' is wrong for agents, 'Agent' is wrong for raw models
Pattern inspired by Vercel AI SDK

name: AbstractLLMProvider
observations: API client factory that holds shared config (apiKey, rateLimiter, cache)
Has forward(args: LLMProviderForwardArgs) method that includes model parameter
Has target(model: string): Target factory method
Uses withKind() static factory method for nominal typing

name: MastraProvider
observations: Wraps Mastra client for agent support
Has agent(agentId, opts?) method returning Target with memory and underlyingModel baked in

name: LLMAsAJudgeScorer
observations: Constructor accepts { target: Target } - model baked into target
Supports weighted criteria with configurable scales
Returns normalized value 0..1, plus modelSlug and provider from target

name: defineRunner
observations: Helper that creates typed runner function
Config: schemaSets (array of testCase/response/score triplets), scorers, runConfigSchema
Runner receives target: Target, not provider
model removed from runConfigSchema - captured at Target construction time

name: OpenRouterProvider
observations: Fetches and caches model list for 24h

name: OpenAIProvider
observations: Wraps OpenAI SDK with built-in retry logic and rate limiting

name: EntityChain
observations: Three core entities: TestCase -> Response -> Score
Every entity has: kind, schemaVersion, namespace fields

name: buildSchemaDefiner
observations: Returns a factory function for schema definitions
Each entity type has its own definer: defineTestCaseSchema, defineResponseSchema, defineScoreSchema
Schemas get .new() and .newWithId() factory methods automatically

name: AbstractScorer
observations: Uses same withKind() pattern as providers
BaseScorerResult: { value: number, explanation?: string, metadata? }

name: AbstractStorage
observations: Abstract base: init(), read(key), readAll(), write(key, value), count()

name: HttpStorage
observations: Remote URL-backed storage with codec pattern

name: AbstractAggregator
observations: Abstract base: push({ score, testCase?, response? }), aggregate(config?)
Designed for streaming: push results one-by-one then aggregate
Avoids materializing entire datasets in memory

name: peerbenchRunner
observations: Built-in runner supporting MCQ and QA test cases
Supports system prompts and Handlebars template variables

name: SDK-Dependencies
observations: openai v6 (for types like ChatCompletionMessageParam, ResponseFormat)
handlebars v4 (for template variables in runners)
decimal.js v10 (for accurate cost calculations in OpenRouter)
jsonrepair v3 (for fixing malformed LLM JSON responses)

name: PackageExports
observations: peerbench → types, errors, utils, constants, helpers (defineRunner, idGeneratorUUIDv7)

name: PathAliases
observations: Uses @/ as path alias (defined in tsconfig.json)

name: ExampleBenchmarks
observations: echo-basic — minimal schema set + runner + storage examples
text-transform — one runner supporting multiple kinds + deterministic scoring
exact-match-scorer — scorer dispatch pattern (algorithmic vs LLM judge)
Built-in peerbench benchmarks under src/benchmarks/peerbench/: MCQ, QA, Multi-turn conversation

name: SimpleSystemPromptSchemaV1
observations: Basic system prompt with content and version fields

name: ExtensionLLMResponseFieldsV1
observations: Fields: data, modelSlug, provider, systemPromptId, token/cost fields

name: ChatResponse
observations: Fields: data, startedAt, completedAt, inputTokensUsed?, outputTokensUsed?, inputCost?, outputCost?, metadata?
